title: NCC 5030 Marketing Management: Premium SUV Survey
purpose: It is part of our Go-To-Market conjoint project for NCC 5030 Marketing Management.
background: What industry do you work in? (e.g., financial services, technology, consulting, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government)

levels.name: Comfort
levels.note: tuned for driver and family, soft suspension, quiet cabin

levels.name: Sporty
levels.note: tuned for driving feel, firm suspension, quick steering

levels.name: Luxury executive
levels.note: tuned for passengers and image, premium materials, rear-seat comfort (e.g. massage, rear screens), formal styling

levels.name: SAE L1
levels.note: the car controls steering OR speed, never both at once; you drive and watch the road at all times

levels.name: SAE L2
levels.note: the car steers AND controls speed together; you must watch the road at all times and are responsible (some systems allow hands off the wheel)

levels.name: SAE L3
levels.note: in defined conditions (e.g. highway traffic jams) the car drives itself and you may look away; you must take over when the car asks

levels.name: EV
levels.note: fully electric vehicle, runs only on its battery, charged by plugging in; no gas engine
